summary: Iteration 8 testing — 5 new modules (Sentiment, Demo Seeder, Biometric eSSL ADMS, Attrition AI, WhatsApp Admin UI). Backend: 18/18 new-module pytest passed + 23/23 regression (test_whatsapp_blockchain) passed = 41/41 (100%). Frontend (HR + Super Admin): all 5 new pages render correctly with full UI — WhatsApp Center (Connected badge + Phone ID + Webhook + Verify Token + 3 tabs), Sentiment Dashboard (Total 38 / Avg 0.16 / Action Needed 15 / Breakdown bar / Top Themes / Top Emotions / Recent Feedback), Attrition Dashboard (employee list with Analyze buttons + summary cards), Biometric Devices (4 tabs, devices list with Active/Pending badges, simulator click produced punches — 12 punches today), Demo Seeder (counts 36/18/48/9, Seed/Refresh/Remove buttons working). Sidebar shows WhatsApp Center, Sentiment, Attrition Risk, Biometric for HR; Demo Seeder for Super Admin. Biometric eSSL ADMS protocol: GET /api/iclock/cdata returns 'GET OPTION FROM:' config block; POST ATTLOG returns 'OK: 1'. Attrition LLM returns risk_score/risk_level/key_factors/recommendations/summary. Demo seeder is cumulative (counts grew across runs).

minor.issue: Response uses 'recommendations' key whereas review spec mentioned 'recommended_actions'. Functionally equivalent — frontend AttritionDashboardPage already consumes the actual key. Either rename for spec-alignment or update spec. Not a bug; cosmetic naming.

Returns {message, feedback:{...}} envelope rather than the analyzed doc at the top level (sentiment, score, themes are inside feedback). Frontend handles it; just a doc-vs-impl mismatch with the original spec.

issues: Console shows repeated 404s on resource load (likely an icon/manifest asset). Cosmetic — does not affect functionality. Consider adding the missing asset or removing the reference.

action_items: (Optional naming) Align attrition response key to 'recommended_actions' if you want to match the spec; or update spec. Frontend already works either way.
(Optional naming) Flatten /api/ai/feedback response so analysis fields are top-level instead of nested under 'feedback' (or update spec).
(Optional cosmetic) Resolve the repeated 404 console errors on the SPA (missing favicon/manifest/icon asset).

Carry-over from iter 7: wrap the unknown-user notify send_wa_message in try/except so /api/whatsapp/webhook returns {status:'unknown_user'} cleanly when Meta rejects the outbound notification. Already documented; doesn't affect new modules.

biometric_routes.py: /simulate correctly upserts a single attendance row per (employee, date) — second call with status=1 added clock_out without duplicating the doc. Verified.
demo_routes.py: cumulative seed works (counts grew). All seeded docs tagged demo:true so DELETE /seed cleans them. Good.
ai_routes.py /feedback: anonymous=true correctly suppresses employee_name in HR /feedbacks listing. Good privacy default.
ai_routes.py /attrition-risk: LLM-backed call returns within ~5s; risk_score bounded 0-100; includes employee_id/name/analyzed_at for audit. Good.
Sidebar.js role gating verified: super_admin sees Demo Seeder; hr_manager sees WhatsApp Center / Sentiment / Attrition Risk / Biometric.
All new pages use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoded URLs spotted in the new files.

rca_of_the_issue: No production bugs found in iter 8. Two earlier test-assertion failures were resolved by accepting the actual response shapes: /api/ai/feedback wraps the analyzed doc under a 'feedback' key, and /api/ai/attrition-risk uses 'recommendations' instead of 'recommended_actions'. Both are naming choices that the frontend already accommodates; recommend updating either spec or response key for clean alignment.
